title: Segment Performance Disparity and Gap Analysis
description: Comparative benchmarking of underperforming cohorts against top-quartile cohorts to isolate root factors.
conditions: Identified underperforming business segment, regional facility, or clinical subgroup
Need to determine what operational attributes distinguish best performers from worst performers
recommended_methods: Feature distribution difference testing (Kolmogorov-Smirnov test and standardized mean difference)
Decision tree surrogate modeling to extract distinguishing rule splits
Information Value (IV) and Weight of Evidence (WoE) ranking of segment attributes
selection_rules: Rank explanatory features by Standardized Mean Difference (SMD > 0.50 indicates substantial disparity)
Train shallow decision tree (depth <= 3) predicting Best vs Worst segment to extract plain-English distinguishing rules
Verify that differences are statistically significant using appropriate hypothesis tests
limitations: Correlation between segment attributes and performance does not prove direct causation
Unobserved confounding variables (e.g. local regional demographics) can drive observed performance gaps
